# Bijou Travel

> Bijou Travel is an independent, boutique travel agency based in Fulham, London (Fulham Broadway, SW6). We design tailor-made holidays, luxury safaris, honeymoons and bespoke journeys worldwide, with a dedicated personal trip designer for every client. Trips are ABTA and ATOL protected.

## Who we serve
- Based in Fulham, London SW6
- Serving travellers across Fulham, Kensington, Chelsea, Hammersmith, Putney, Wandsworth, Battersea, Chiswick and the rest of London, plus clients throughout the UK
- Founded by Tess, founder and lead trip designer
